jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
Connect Senior Services has been a non-profit serving seniors for over 50 years. We believe in the power of connection, joy, and faith to transform lives. We provide opportunities for seniors to experience these through a thriving community that provides housing, events, dining and need based services. We look to help eliminate food scarcity, social isolation, and to provide fair priced housing. We want people who are passionate about these same goals and our vision.

As our development coordinator you will oversee our development program: you will solicit gifts, plan and hold events, develop fundraising materials, and you will meet frequently with current and potential donors. Working each day to connect donors’ philanthropic interests with our ministry priorities, you will blend your professional knowledge, relationship building skills and talent with philanthropic strategies. The development officer will play a key role on our development program to help identify, qualify, cultivate, solicit, and steward major gifts to Upland Manor.

Responsibilities

Project manage peer-to-peer fundraising events for the organization
Project manage distinguished events (ex. Annual Gala); coordinate volunteers, secure table sponsorships, etc.
Assume full responsibility for various fundraising efforts including product sales, obtaining items for sale in auctions and acquiring donations
Partner with CEO to generate organizational collateral
Steward volunteers and elevate advocates to supporting fundraising events
Manage individual donor portfolio utilizing CRM; maintain accurate data and run reports from system
Acts as a thought leader in the development area and contributes new and innovative approaches or ideas
Works closely with CEO and other team members to strategize & implement Development initiatives
Cultivate relationships with donors (small and large), businesses and churches.
Maintain development communications and social media platforms.
Engage in regular development and leadership training.
Participate and manage capital campaigns as needed.
Other duties, as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree required, Master’s or relevant certification, a plus
1-3+ years of professional experience in the development field, preferably event-, or individual-giving focused
Advanced project management skills and ability to navigate in a fast-paced environment with a solid track-record of following through on commitments
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; written and verbal fluency, Spanish, or another language, a plus
Willing and able to travel domestically, on occasion

Skills And Attributes

High attention to detail and a high standard for quality work product
Passion for superior customer service and flexibility to do what it takes to ensure customer satisfaction
Comfort working in a periodic high-paced and high-workload environment
Ability to manage a full email inbox and respond to emails in a timely manner
Mission driven, enthusiastic, dependable, positive, self-starting

Interested applicants can send a resume to Nicholas Hankins, the CEO of Connect Senior Services: nick@connectliving.org

jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. Waymo Operations exists to deliver the Waymo Driver to the world. We are a global team building and scaling the world's first and leading autonomous fleet and operations platform. From component sourcing to end customer management, we enable and create value for Waymo through scaled and orchestrated deployment of the Waymo Driver. At Waymo, we are dedicated to building a culture that promotes collaboration and celebration. We value our team members' unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences and support and encourage all team members to share their ideas to help Waymo better serve the communities in which we operate.

Own the end-to-end operational control, training, SOP development, and growth of the Emergency Response Team, including supporting the Escalation Manager Ops On-Call program both domestically and internationally.

8+ years in operations, program management, emergency and disaster planning

Bachelor’s degree in Emergency Management, Homeland Security, Public Policy, Operations Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

A proven track record of scaling emergency response teams, on-call programs, and escalation management frameworks across multiple domestic and international regions
Experience managing emergency response, incident management, or physical safety operations within a tech company, ride-sharing platform, autonomous vehicle (AV) company, or large logistics/fleet network

Background working directly with public safety agencies, emergency services (PSAPs), law enforcement, and city officials to coordinate safety efforts during major public events or crises
Certifications such as Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), Associate Business Continuity Professional (ABCP), or structural frameworks like FEMA’s National Incident Management System (NIMS) / Incident Command System (ICS) (specifically ICS 100, 200, 700, 800)
Experience managing queue prioritization, tooling outages, and operational bandwidth (e.g., dynamically throttling or routing support requests by market during a localized crisis

Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

We are seeking a passionate and talented Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. You will turn complex data from our Medicine Supply Map into actionable insights that drive decision-making, operational improvements, and ensure the availability of quality medicines.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Data Analyst Has The Following Responsibilities

Gather, clean, preprocess, and maintain datasets from the Medicine Supply Map and related sources.

Conduct statistical analysis and hypothesis testing to uncover trends, patterns, and anomalies.
Design, plan, and execute data quality and testing activities: validate datasets, uncover data issues, check pipeline integrity, and implement consistency checks.
Participate in data-driven testing (e.g., scripted or parameterized tests) to ensure accuracy of metrics and model outputs.
Develop clear dashboards, visualizations, and reports using tools like Python (Pandas, Matplotlib), R, SQL, Tableau, SAS.
Monitor data pipelines, verify data flow correctness, and troubleshoot discrepancies.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define reporting needs and deliver actionable insights.
Perform root cause and diagnostic analytics to understand supply disruptions or demand shifts.
Share insights through presentations, written reports, and visual storytelling.
Document testing procedures, data validation steps, and analytical methodology.
Stay current on emerging analytics, testing tools, and best practices in healthcare/pharmaceutical data.

Who is USP Looking For?

The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Public Health, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
Proficiency in data cleaning, transformation, and analysis using Python (Pandas), R, SQL, Tableau, SAS, or similar tools.
Strong statistical foundation: hypothesis testing, trend analysis, descriptive and diagnostic statistics.
Experience building dashboards or visualizations to communicate data insights clearly.
Excellent analytical thinking and attention to detail; ability to translate business questions into data queries.
Strong communication skills—able to present complex findings to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and manage multiple data requests.
Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced, healthcare or pharmaceutical-oriented environment.
Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical supply chains, or life sciences domains.
Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as IBM Cognos or Power BI.

Experience with ETL/pipeline frameworks (e.g. Kedro, Airflow) for reproducible workflows.
Previous project experience using Python/R/SQL in predictive modeling, dashboarding, data mining, or statistical analysis.
Prior roles involving data storytelling or decision support in healthcare settings
10 years of technical professional working experience.

Additional Desired Preferences

PhD or similar level of research experience.

Supervisory Responsibilities
: None, this is an individual contributor role.

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

USD $83,368– $118,800 annually.

10%

Job Description:

The School of Engineering at Brown University has a new and exciting opportunity to hire a Research Assistant.

The Research assistant will support the Health Innovation Technology Sandbox (HITS) in the Brown University School of Engineering. The incumbent will work on the design, fabrication, and testing of wearable health monitoring sensors, including those using photoplethysmography (PPG), kinematic sensors, and AI enhanced sensors. Daily tasks include: performing optical experiments, electronics development, signal processing, data analysis, presenting results regularly at lab meetings and working jointly with other lab members on development of an equitable pulse oximeter. Position will also assist with on-going clinical studies.

This is a full-time, fixed term position for one year, but is eligible for extension with secured external funding.

Excellent communication skills, written and verbal with a professional demeanor in all communications, including but not limited to emails, reports, meetings and presentations.
The candidate must produce quality work that prioritizes accuracy and thoroughness.
Treats co-workers with respect, honesty, and fairness. Resolves issues effectively and is viewed as a positive team member and/or colleague.
Ability to work independently and implement short- and long-term goals independently, but also as a strong team member when the situation warrants.
Demonstrated mastery of MS/Office, matlab
Demonstrated ability to support a community of diverse perspectives and cultures in an inclusive environment.
Incumbent must be highly professional and able to interact successfully with individuals at all levels.
Travel may be required for assisting in field research.
Occasional presentations of research findings to internal and external collaborators may

be required.
